// why: bun runs these files directly and needs no build step, so this config is
not a build config — it exists so 'type-checks clean under strict' can be
reproduced by anyone instead of asserted.
bun add -d @types/bun typescript   # once, in this dir or any ancestor (repo root works)
bunx tsc --noEmit -p .             # expects: no output, exit 0
